profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA. It is publicly traded on the NASDAQ under the ticker AAPL, carries a CIK of 0000320193, and reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the fiscal year ending September 27, 2025, as filed in its 10-K.

The company's AI offerings center on Apple Intelligence, described on its site as helpful AI that is integrated into apps, grounded in user context, and private at every step. The next generation of Apple Intelligence and Siri is said to be coming later in the year, bringing capabilities to iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. Siri AI, powered by Apple Intelligence, is presented as a conversational assistant able to answer open-ended questions, take actions in apps such as Messages, Music, and Reminders, generate or edit written drafts, automate tasks via Shortcuts, and reference online information for current answers. The site notes that Siri AI will initially be available in English, will not initially be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS, and requires an Apple Intelligence-enabled device.

Beyond Apple Intelligence and Siri, the held facts also track Final Cut Pro AI, a Mac video editing product with on-device processing optimized for Apple silicon, and iMovie AI, a consumer video editing tool with trailer templates, both described as privacy-first and processed on-device. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded for Apple in the held facts.
